definitions.explanation: The inherent or essential qualities of a person or thing.
The characteristics or attributes of a substance or object.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧{性質|せいしつ}です。
{性質|せいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やかな→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です。
examples.english: I like people with a calm disposition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{性質上|せいしつじょう}、⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧です。
examples.english: Due to the nature of my work, I travel often.
examples.notes: {性質上|せいしつじょう} = by the nature of

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{性質|せいしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the properties of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{性質|せいしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べています→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I'm investigating the properties of this substance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧{性質|せいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine has the property of reducing fever.

notes:
{性質|せいしつ} refers to inherent nature or properties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{性質|せいしつ} (the nature of ~)
- {性質|せいしつ}⟦{上|じょう}→上：noentry⟧ (by nature, due to the nature of)
- {性質|せいしつ}が⟦{良|よ}い→よい：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad natured)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: personality (for people)
- {性質|せいしつ}: nature (people or things)
- ⟦{特性|とくせい}→特性：13517_tokusei⟧: characteristic, property (technical)
- ⟦{気質|きしつ}→気質：13256_kishitsu⟧: temperament, disposition
